violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. - Wiping clothes should be stored in a sanitizer solution when not used. Spray sanitizer is allowable, but the towel if used is a one time use.

Hot storage of potentially hazardous food. — --Hot food storage facilities/equipment * was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining temperature of potentially hazardous food at 140F or greater. - Hot hold food temp was 120*F. Hot hold food should be held at 140*F or above.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil * was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. - Utensils should be stored in a Dip well with continuous running water to agitate and move food debris, not in a cup of stagnate water.
